entities.summary: Walid Mimoun (b. 1959-03-19, Bni Sidel Jbel) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bni Sidel Jbel and Morocco. Known in the fields of morocco, composers & musicians, africa.
